_readme: AVA-07 — the stickers a child picks, one per level from level 1 on.
Hand-drawn, own rights: no attribution field. Not generated, and
deliberately outside the gitignored species bundle directories.
One entry per sticker. `id` is the scientific name in lower case with
underscores, and the image is images/<id>.png (or .webp): transparent
background, 512 x 512 px, one bird per file, white sticker edge drawn in.
`scientificName` links the sticker to the taxonomy, which supplies the
bird's common name in every locale. `names` is optional and wins over
the taxonomy: use it for a child-friendly name ('Kiwi' rather than
'Nordstreifenkiwi') or for a bird BirdNET does not know at all (the
shoebill). A locale missing from `names` falls back to the taxonomy,
The fact lives in facts_<locale>.json under the same id. German and
English ship; every other locale falls back to English, and a new
language is added by dropping in another facts_<locale>.json.
The order below is the order of the album.
Never reuse or rename an id once shipped: a child's saved picks refer
to it. Removing an entry hides the sticker but keeps the pick.
